defs.def: happening or done without involving other people, actions, etc. in between 直接的；亲自的；亲身的

ex.s: Upon entering the correct zone, parking staff will guide you directly to a space.
ex.t: 进入正确的区域后，停车工作人员会直接引导你到车位。

ex.s: As the snow came down more and more heavily, Emily was directed off the highway.
ex.t: 雪越下越大，Emily被引导驶离了高速公路。

ex.s: Speak directly to what matters to them.
ex.t: 它有超过2500家租赁店。

ex.s: This directly impacts how our brain processes motivation and willpower.
ex.t: 几年前，零浪费是一种激进的生活方式运动。

ex.s: That is a good example of why — no matter how complex our models are or may one day be — we need direct observation of the natural world.
ex.t: 很长一段时间，这个小家伙看着我的眼睛，左右转动着头。

ex.s: Direct observation is a must for scientific research.
ex.t: 5. — 迈克下周将宣布他从职业足球退役。

ex.s: Carson uses a simple, direct style common to fable.
ex.t: 卡森采用寓言常见的朴素、直接的风格。

ex.s: She again looked directly into my eyes, then let out a squeaking call and was gone.
ex.t: 她再次直视我的眼睛，发出一声尖细的鸣叫后离开了。

ex.s: *Apply directly by clicking “Apply Now” button.
ex.t: *点击"Apply Now"按钮直接申请。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天都会有所不同，但学生必须准备好完成简短的课堂写作或测试，这些内容直接来自指定阅读材料或上一堂课的讲座/讨论笔记，因此上课时仔细记笔记很重要。

ex.s: More researchers, policymakers and representatives from the food industry must learn to look beyond their direct lines of responsibility and adopt a systems approach.
ex.t: 更多研究人员、政策制定者和食品行业代表必须学会超越其直接责任范围，采用系统思维的方法。

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，已有超过五亿美元进入该基金，购买了超过500万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: What is a direct result of the Act passed in 1934?
ex.t: 邮票价格下降了。

ex.s: He directed some high quality movies.
ex.t: 他专注于扮演正剧角色。

ex.s: “Let's look directly into the issue of collapse,” they say, “and deal with the terrible possibilities of what we see there to make the best of a troubling future.”
ex.t: "让我们直接面对崩溃问题，"他们说，"并处理我们所看到的可怕可能性以便在令人担忧的未来中尽力而为。"

ex.s: Talk directly to your audience, be yourself and make a connection.
ex.t: 直接与听众交流，做真实的自己，建立联系。

ex.s: You can be the one who directs the conversation to fun topics that are ripe for others to add humor.
ex.t: 你可以成为那个引导对话走向有趣话题的人，让其他人有机会添加幽默元素。

ex.s: Directed sound is also beginning to appear in shopping centers and even at homes.
ex.t: 餐馆可以在提供各种食物选择的同时提供音乐选择，让顾客更多地控制就餐氛围。

ex.s: They can be directed onto a specific area.
ex.t: 它们可以转化为能量。

ex.s: Directed sound can be used for ________. （    ）
ex.t: 它们可以被导向特定区域。

ex.s: We work directly for our leaners, not for any third party.
ex.t: 数百万学习者都有自己的故事和学习新语言的理由。

ex.s: A．The prey species they directly attack will die out．
ex.t: A．有广泛的猎物选择

ex.s: I quickly lower myself, ducking my head to avoid    64    (look) directly into his eyes so he doesn’t feel    65   (challenge).
ex.t: 我迅速蹲下身子，低下头避免____64____（look）直视它的眼睛，以免让它感到____65____（challenge）被挑衅。

ex.s: Researchers have found that there is a direct link between the increase in food eaten outside the home and the rise in   64  (weigh) problems.
ex.t: 你可能也会开始注意到这不仅对你的健康有影响，而且对你的钱包也有影响。

ex.s: The word history of typhoon had a far less direct path to the English language than gung-ho.
ex.t: 并非所有历史记载都是相同的。

ex.s: The low point of the sheet must be centered directly over, and no more than three inches above, the cup.
ex.t: 如果三年前有人告诉我我会把大部分周末时间花在露营上。

ex.s: This production of Shakespeare’s Richard III will be directed by the National’s Associate Director, Wang Xiaoying.
ex.t: 这版莎士比亚《理查三世》将由国家剧院副院长王小英执导。

ex.s: Shakespeare’s Richard III will be directed by the National’s Associate Director，Wang Xiaoying.
ex.t: 21.中国国家剧院将上演哪部戏剧？

ex.s: He directed the wasted water into shallow basins where it froze, and was stored until the spring.
ex.t: 他将这些浪费的水引入浅水池中冻结储存，直到春天使用。

ex.s: Now we have the most direct evidence yet that he is right.
ex.t: 这些过程的发生是为了防止我们的大脑被记忆填满。

defs.def: going in the straightest line between two places without stopping or changing direction 笔直的；径直的；最近的
with nothing between sth and the source of the heat or light 直射的
saying exactly what you mean in a way that nobody can pretend not to understand 直爽的；直率的；坦率的

ex.s: That way, PASS directly responds to your needs and feedback.
ex.t: 这样，PASS直接响应你的需求和反馈。

defs.def: related through parents and children rather than brothers, sisters, aunts, etc. 直系的；嫡系的

ex.s: Artist Michael Craig-Martin said: “Andria's brilliant project to bring artists from all fields into direct contact with children is particularly welcome at a time when the arts are being downgraded in schools." It was a mistake to see the arts as unnecessary, he added.
ex.t: 历史学家西蒙·沙玛爵士也是这个项目的支持者。

ex.s: This is quite important, because it is directly related to your commitment.
ex.t: 这非常重要，因为它直接关系到你的投入程度。

defs.def: to aim sth in a particular direction or at a particular person 把 … 对准（某方向或某人）

ex.s: The noise from the LRAD is directed like a ray of light and travels only into the ears of that person, but it is not deadly.
ex.t: 它发出震耳欲聋的声音，痛苦到足以暂时使人丧失行动能力。

defs.def: to control or be in charge of sb/sth 管理；监督；指导

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: （5）这篇文章的最佳标题可能是？

defs.def: to be in charge of actors in a play, or a film/movie, or musicians in an orchestra, etc. 导演（戏剧或电影）；指挥（管弦乐队）
to tell or show sb how to get to somewhere or where to go 给（某人）指路；为（某人）领路
to give an official order 指示；命令
to send a letter, etc. to a particular place or to a particular person 把（信件等）寄至；交予

ex.s: Because the moon’s body blocks direct radio communication with a probe, China first had to put a satellite in orbit above the moon in a spot   63   it could send signals to the spacecraft and to Earth.
ex.t: 因为月球本体阻挡了与探测器的直接无线电通信，中国首先必须在月球上方轨道的一个位置放置一颗卫星，   63   在那里它可以向航天器和地球发送信号。

defs.def: without stopping or changing direction 直接；径直

ex.s: When you make a suggestion, use less direct language than you would to make a statement or give an order.
ex.t: 当你提建议时，用的语言要比陈述事实或下命令时更委婉。

ex.s: We flew directly to Hong Kong.
ex.t: 我们直飞香港。

ex.s: Background information Troy is a 2004 American movie directed by Wolfgang Petersen and loosely based on Homer’s epic The Iliad.
ex.t: 背景信息：《特洛伊》是一部2004年的美国电影，由沃尔夫冈·彼得森执导，大致改编自荷马史诗《伊利亚特》。

ex.s: Tell him directly and honestly that you were talking without thinking.
ex.t: 直接而诚实地告诉他，你是说话不过脑子。

ex.s: In more good news, to write and direct Hollywood films is more common than before for women.
ex.t: 更好的消息是，对女性来说，撰写和执导好莱坞电影比以前更普遍了。

defs.def: without involving other people 亲自；直接
